svg.title: RSO Launch-Date Object Grid 2026-04-16
svg.desc: A launch-date-sorted grid of the 2026-04-16 RSO archive. Objects with LAUNCH_DATE are shown in the main quilt. Objects without LAUNCH_DATE are shown in a side grid sorted by NORAD_CAT_ID.
svg.text: 67,157 archived objects | sorted by LAUNCH_DATE, then NORAD_CAT_ID | 2026-04-16 snapshot
